impacts.text: This check can be exploited by an attacker to prevent a legitimate instance from being registered to a valid service, effectively locking it indefinitely.
When Bob attempts to register the same instance to the legitimate service, the transaction fails due to the instance already being registered elsewhere.
Because Alice controls the fake service, she can keep it alive indefinitely, permanently blocking Bob from using his instance.
In cases where an agent instance holds funds and is non-upgradeable, being registered to a malicious service can render it permanently unusable
leading to a complete loss of those funds.
